english.note: Use this comparative expression when someone lives longer than another person or something lasts longer than another thing.

examples.english: This old car will survive longer than that new one.
examples.traditional: 呢架舊車長命過嗰架新車。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 gau6 ce1 coeng4 meng6 gwo3 go2 gaa3 san1 ce1
